messages.text:
**Completed**
- Created the navigable 15-slide English guide at `index.html:1`.
- Included 10 distinct squid methods attributed to Korean, Japanese, Cantonese/Hong Kong, Taiwanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Filipino, and Macanese traditions.
- Every recipe slide includes quantities, preparation and cooking steps, timing, source link, and YouTube cooking-video link.
- Added keyboard, touch/swipe, arrow-button, slide-index, progress-bar, URL-hash, and print/PDF navigation.
- Stored all generated food imagery locally in `assets/food-grid-east.png`, `assets/food-grid-southeast.png`, and `assets/food-diptych.png`.
- Validated 15 slides, 10 recipe links, 10 YouTube links, local assets, and navigation hooks. Some recipe sites reject automated checks with `403` bot protection but remain browser-accessible.
